## Overview {#overview .course-home-heading}

Welcome to **Modern Artificial Intelligence** course (2026–2027).

This course combines rigorous mathematical foundations with practical systems engineering: reading research papers alongside code, implementing components from scratch, and executing a capstone applied project.
